thread:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH GPU POOL PRESSURE in us-west-2 (hotset-3). Avg queue latency > 2s, 503s observed. Auto-evac triggered. Escalation level: P1.

alice: oncall ack. jumping in. looking at dashboards now.

bob: i'm on standby, checking node preemptions and autoscaler events.

alice: initial check — autoscaler reported 8 preemptions in last 5m, thin provision threshold hit. routing to fallback pools started. customer-facing errors spiking for low-priority tenants.

carol: tagging for customer impact — which customers hit? sending note to CS.

dmitri: got a few DM's from two enterprise customers reporting timeouts. opening a quick incident note. will draft hold message once we know scope.

elaine: quick note: model serving queues are backfilling, but KV cache misses increased ~4x. suspect hotspot on hotset-3.

bob: confirming preemptions from cloud provider logs: interruption_reason=CPU-oversubscription, provider-event-id=ev-38421. scaling worked but not fast enough.

alice: plan: 1) keep fallback routing on, 2) increase reserved capacity for hotset-3 by temporary placement (if possible), 3) start controlled evac of affected shards to eu-west-1 as a last resort. any objections?

frank: +1 to temporary reserve. I've opened infra ticket INF-9821 to request burst capacity from cloud account team.

carol: customer comms: propose short message: "We observed elevated inference latency in us-west-2 due to GPU host interruptions. We've routed traffic to fallback pools; some customers may see higher latencies. We're working on restoring full capacity." want to send in 15.

dmitri: that works, add: "No customer data was exposed."

alice: execute: frank, continue INF-9821. bob/elaine, can you triage hotset nodes and attempt a live drain for most impacted pools? avoid broad evacuations if possible.

bob: starting live node drains now, will mark nodes as unsched. using runbook snippet:
```
# drain node
kubectl cordon gpu-node-07
kubectl drain gpu-node-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

elaine: paused some long-running low-priority jobs, freed ~2 GPUs within 8m. KV cache warms taking ~6m.

alice: good. frank, update if cloud can provide burst. frank: pinging provider support now.

frank: provider responded: can add 4 gpus in 20 mins, approval required. requesting expedited approval.

alice: thanks. keep fallback routing for 30m. carol/dmitri, prepare post for status page and customer outreach.

carol: will post on status.redwood.ai "Degraded performance - us-west-2" and include remediation steps.

incident-bot: Update: autoscaler cooldown triggered; fallback routing active. Incident tag: gpu-hotset-usw2-1768642000.

bob: verifying degraded queues dropping from 2s->1.2s after two node drains. errors from low-priority tenants declining.

dmitri: sent templated notice to impacted customers with escalation contacts. one customer on premium asked for ETA; gave 30-45m.

frank: cloud approved burst, 4 gpus coming online in 18m. scheduling probe to re-enable standard routing once capacity observed stable for 2 evaluation windows.

alice: ok. once cloud capacity is in we will: 1) disable fallback, 2) rebalance KV caches, 3) run smoke checks. set a checkpoint in 30m for post-incident.

elaine: noted smoke tests: identity requests, streaming latency, per-model p50/p95 checks. I'll prepare check commands.

alice: moving to post-incident planning: we need a postmortem and action items. propose 2d async writeup + 1h sync review with infra/serving/product. who owns?

bob: i'll draft the technical timeline and root cause (preemptions + scaling lag). assign remediation items: autoscaler tune, thin-provision thresholds, preemption-aware placement.

carol: i'll handle customer-impact summary and external comms review.

frank: infra will follow up on cloud quota & burst process; INF-9821 will capture steps and follow-up with provider contact.

dmitri: CS will collect list of impacted customers and prepare outreach follow-ups.

alice: scheduling: postmortem doc due by 1768810000 (2d). sync review on 1768820000 (calendar invite sent). owner: alice (coord), bob (tech lead), carol (impact).

alice: action items immediate:
- A1 (bob): Change autoscaler cooldown + add headroom metric. JIRA: INFRA-1402. due 1w.
- A2 (elaine): Add KV cache warmup telemetry and faster rebuild paths. JIRA: SERV-3431. due 2w.
- A3 (frank): Formalize cloud burst approval playbook and contact list. INF-9821 -> FR-55. due 3d.
- A4 (carol+dmitri): Customer follow-up notes + premium account check-ins. CS-224. due 2d.

bob: I'll also add a runbook tweak to detect provider preemption patterns and auto-shift to reserved pools earlier.

alice: let's use the incident channel for all updates and link the PM doc here. I'll create the postmortem doc now: https://redwood-internal.docs/postmortems/gpu-hotset-usw2-1768642000

carol: added customer comms drafts to doc. dmitri please review.

dmitri: reviewed, small wording changes done. ready to send final customer follow-ups once postmortem is published.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: capacity restored and fallback disabled at 1768645400. Duration ~57m.

alice: closing notes: system recovered, no data exposure, impacted low-priority tenants primarily, small set of premium customers experienced timeouts. postmortem timeline and actions assigned. thanks all. :heart:
